objective: test whether a prospective fewer-species higher-photo-count RGFCA sharedness design is physically feasible using metadata only

pilot_species_selection.eligible_pool: rows with raw_results == 200 in the complete v3 capacity audit
pilot_species_selection.rank: ascending SHA-256 of the ASCII decimal iNaturalist taxon ID, then ascending taxon ID

feasibility_rule.primary: at least 150 of the fixed 500 pilot species reach 300 after observer cap
feasibility_rule.secondary: report number reaching 400 without a pass/fail requirement
feasibility_rule.reason: 150 species is the upper end of the prespecified 100-150 species prospective design range; this is a capacity gate, not a power gate

failure_and_censoring.request_error: retain species; do not replace; overall pilot not evaluable if more than 5 percent of fixed species have any terminal request error
failure_and_censoring.page_cap_reached_before_target: mark right-censored/indeterminate for that target, never call it confirmed insufficient
failure_and_censoring.api_exhausted_before_target: confirmed below target under the frozen metadata rules

claim_ceiling: This pilot can establish metadata availability for a higher-depth acquisition design only. It cannot establish classifiable yield, sharedness power, flower-specificity, ecological signal, or authorize image acquisition.
